The '''1992–93 Primeira Divisão''' was the [[Primeira Liga#All-time Primeira Liga table|59th edition]] of top flight of Portuguese football. It started on 30 August 1992 with a match between [[Vitória S.C.|Vitória de Guimarães]] and [[S.C. Beira-Mar|Beira-Mar]], and ended on 13 June 1993. The league was contested by 18 clubs with [[FC Porto|Porto]] as the defending champions.

Porto qualified for the [[1993–94 UEFA Champions League]] first round, Benfica qualified for the [[1993–94 European Cup Winners' Cup]] first round, and [[Sporting CP]], [[Boavista F.C.|Boavista]] and [[C.S. Marítimo|Marítimo]] qualified for the [[1993–94 UEFA Cup]]; in opposite, [[F.C. Tirsense|Tirsense]], [[S.C. Espinho|Espinho]] and [[G.D. Chaves|Chaves]] were relegated to the [[Liga de Honra]]. [[Jorge Cadete]] was the top scorer with 17 goals.

==Promotion and relegation==

===Teams relegated to [[Liga de Honra]]===
*[[S.C.U. Torreense|Torreense]]
*[[F.C. Penafiel|Penafiel]]
*[[C.F. União|União da Madeira]]

Torreense, Penafiel, and União da Madeira were consigned to the Liga de Honra following their final classification in [[1991–92 Primeira Divisão|1991-92 season]].

===Teams promoted from Liga de Honra===
*[[SC Espinho|Espinho]]
*[[C.F. Os Belenenses|Belenenses]]
*[[F.C. Tirsense|Tirsense]]

The other three teams were replaced by Espinho, Belenenses, and Tirsense from the Liga de Honra.
